AgeGroupProgram.title: Curriculum Designed for <accent>Every Stage</accent>
AgeGroupProgram.subtitle: We've tailored our lessons to match your child's developmental milestones, ensuring learning sticks at every age.

programs.title: Money Basics for Little Learners
programs.description: Fun, story-based lessons that introduce kids to needs vs wants, simple saving goals, and positive money habits in a playful way.
programs.details: Story-led missions, needs vs wants sorting, three-jar saving, and mini parent prompts you can do in under 10 minutes.

programs.title: Smart Money Explorers
programs.description: Introduces budgeting, earning allowance, and saving challenges, helping kids make smarter money decisions early on.
programs.details: Budgeting games, allowance planners, saving challenges, first bank vocabulary, and quick parent tips to keep habits consistent.

programs.title: Teen Wealth Builders
programs.description: Covers budgeting & banking, investing basics, and entrepreneurial thinking to prepare teens for real-world financial independence.
programs.details: Practice budgets, mock debit/credit scenarios, beginner investing with simulations, and small business exercises with feedback.

faqItems.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqItems.answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time by clicking the 'Cancel subscription' button in your plan details above. Your access will continue until the end of your current billing period.

faqItems.question: Can I switch plans later?
faqItems.answer: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, while downgrades start at the next billing cycle.

faqItems.question: Where can I find my invoices?
faqItems.answer: All your past invoices are listed in the 'Billing History' section on this page. You can download them as PDF files.

FounderQuote.quote: School teaches our children how to work for money. At Zaza Academy, we teach them how to make money work for them.

This academy was created to close an important gap with one clear goal: learning that feels like play, yet delivers real-life confidence and results.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked <accent>Questions</accent>
FAQ.subtitle: Answers to help you feel confident about your child's learning journey with Zaza Academy.

items.question: What if my child misses a class?
items.answer: All live classes are recorded and added to your dashboard within 24 hours. Your child can watch the replay anytime and complete the activities at their own pace.

items.question: Do parents need to attend?
items.answer: For ages 5-7, we suggest parents stay nearby for the first sessions. For 8+, the program is built for independent learning, and parents are always welcome to observe.

items.question: What ages can enroll?
items.answer: We offer tailored programs for three age groups: 5-7 (Money Basics), 8-11 (Smart Money Explorers), and 12-16 (Teen Wealth Builders).

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and Apple Pay. Choose between quarterly or annual billing to suit your family.

items.question: Is it available in English and French?
items.answer: Yes. Zaza Academy is fully bilingual. You can choose your preferred language for lessons and materials in your account settings.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: Welcome to Zaza Academy. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring a safe online environment for all users, especially children. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and handle personal information in accordance with COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) and GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation).

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information necessary to provide our educational services. For parents: detailed contact and billing information. For children: minimal information such as a username (we encourage not using real names) and progress data. We do not collect persistent identifiers for behavioral advertising from children.

sections.title: 2. Children's Privacy (COPPA Compliance)
sections.content: Zaza Academy is designed for children. In compliance with COPPA, we require verifiable parental consent before collecting any personal information from a child under 13. Parents have full control over their child's account and can review, edit, or delete their child's information at any time.

sections.title: 3. GDPR Rights
sections.content: If you are a resident of the EEU, you have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of your personal data. You specifically have the 'Right to be Forgotten'. To exercise these rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer.

sections.title: 4. Data Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. This includes encryption in transit and at rest, and strict access controls.

sections.title: 5. Contact Us
sections.content:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: 
Email: privacy@zazaacademy.com
